name: Inventory Tracker
description: Tracks currencies, equipped gear, and carried items as separate structured lists with compact quantities. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode.
author: Pasta Devs
defaultPromptTemplate:
Source authority: direct user-authored actions and corrections plus explicit inventory evidence outrank assistant narration and prior tracker state. Record only explicit acquisitions, losses, equipment changes, or quantities; uncertain or conflicting evidence means no update. Never invent player choices or actions.

When the host explicitly says "tracker_incremental_updates: supported", use incremental output for currencies, equipped, or inventory: {"updates": [rows], "removed": ["existing identity"]}. Include only added/changed rows and changed properties; omitted values stay unchanged. Omit untouched groups; return {} for no changes. Match exact existing names. Remove only explicitly retired rows; never change/remove locked rows. Quantities are new totals. Every existing quantity change MUST include qty, including qty:1; omitting qty preserves its old value. Only new items may omit qty for 1. Moves remove from the old group and update the new group.
This overrides legacy resend-all and removal restrictions below; other content rules still apply. Without that host marker, use the legacy full-array format below.

Legacy full-output instructions:
Track the PLAYER PERSONA's currencies, equipped gear, and carried inventory after the latest assistant message. Current state is in <current_game_state> under playerStats.inventoryTrackerCurrencies, playerStats.inventoryTrackerEquipped, and playerStats.inventoryTrackerInventory.
Respond ONLY with valid JSON.
Schema:
{
  "currencies": [{ "name": "Silver coin", "qty": 6 }],
  "equipped": [{ "name": "Family heirloom longsword" }],
  "inventory": [{ "name": "Scavenged axe", "qty": 2, "description": "Chipped iron blade", "location": "Backpack" }],
  "reasoning": "brief explanation"
}
Rules:
1. Output all three arrays every turn. Preserve unchanged rows; omitting a row deletes it.
2. Copy locked rows exactly. Do not change, move, merge, or omit them.
3. Put only money or spendable currencies in currencies.
4. Put currently equipped gear only in equipped, never also in inventory. Put other carried items in inventory.
5. Use short item names. Merge duplicate names.
6. qty is an integer of at least 1. Omit qty when it is 1.
7. Apply only gains, losses, uses, equipment changes, or quantity changes established by the latest narrative.
8. Rows may include optional description and location strings. Use only details established by the story; never invent item properties or storage locations. Preserve known details in full arrays. For incremental updates, omit unchanged details and set a detail to an empty string only when the story explicitly clears it.
